engine: 11tanjung's section hand-off — the NEXT section is a coloured PANEL with a big rounded top edge (border-radius ~40-60px) that RISES from below (translateY 100% -> 0) and slides OVER the previous section, flipping the theme (brown <-> cream — the panel carries its own colour). The panel's content fades + lifts in DURING the rise, reaching readable by ~70% of the travel. ONE pinned scroll-scrub, ~2.1s. Harvested from D_11tanjung (C4).

measured_teardown.move: progress p 0..1 (pinned). Panel translateY = (100 - ease(p)*100)% — starts fully below the fold (only its rounded top peeks), ends seated covering the previous section. ease = power3.out (fast rise, settling tail). The outgoing section behind it holds (optional small parallax-up as it's covered). The panel content (.pro-rise) reveals over [contentFrom .. 1]: opacity 0 -> 1 + translateY 28px -> 0, so the copy lands as the panel seats (readable ~p>=0.7). The rounded leading edge is a static border-top-radius on the panel.
measured_teardown.cited: 11tanjung C4: the next section rises from below with a big rounded top (~40-60px arc) translateY up OVER the previous section + a theme-flip (brown<->cream, the panel is itself coloured); the content appears DURING the rise (~70% of the height = text already readable); scroll-linked ~2.1s.

radius.what: the panel's top corner radius — the rounded leading edge that reads as the 'curtain lip'. 40-60px is the 11tanjung range.

pinFactor.what: length of the pinned scroll span (end = +innerHeight*pinFactor) — tunes the ~2.1s feel; higher = slower rise.

contentFrom.what: progress at which the panel content starts revealing (opacity + lift). 0.45 -> readable by ~0.7 (text up before the panel fully seats), matching C4.

prevParallax.what: how far the outgoing section drifts UP as the panel covers it (0 = still). A small value (~40) adds depth to the hand-off.

ease.what: the rise curve (fast start, long settle). 'expo.out' for a harder snap, 'power2.out' for a gentler one.

manageLenis.what: if true and Lenis is present, the component owns a Lenis instance + ticker; set false when the page already drives a shared Lenis (lab sets false).

entry: PanelRiseOver.create(target, opts) -> { trigger, lenis, set(p), refresh(), destroy }. target = .pro-stage wrapping .pro-prev (the outgoing section) + .pro-panel (the rising coloured panel, content marked .pro-rise). set(p 0..1) is a PURE scrub (0 = panel fully below, 1 = panel seated + content in).
law: transform: translateY (panel + content) + opacity (content) + a STATIC border-top-radius on the panel only; GPU; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop over the panel; NO WebGL; reduced-motion or <=820px -> panel seated (covering), no pin. owns_pin TRUE. The theme-flip is just the panel's own bg/ink vs the prev section's — no blend math. GSAP + ScrollTrigger required for the scroll path; set(p) works standalone for previews/snapshots.
gate_mode: owns_pin scroll-scrub. Verify the panel translateY curve (100% -> 0, power3.out), the static rounded top radius, and the content reveal window (starts contentFrom, readable ~0.7) + fps/jank. ScrollTrigger pins at stage top==viewport top; to screenshot a true mid-rise, binary-search the scroll for the target translateY% (the pin offset != raw page scroll). Do NOT create() a second instance (two pins on one element conflict).
proven: lab: OUR QUADRO aerial render (brown section) -> a cream panel rises over it. Curve measured live (p / panel-translateY / content-opacity): 0 / 100% / 0 -> 0.20 / 51.2% / 0 -> 0.45 / 16.6% / 0 -> 0.60 / 6.4% / 0.61 -> 0.70 / 2.7% / 0.84 -> 0.85 / 0.34% / 0.98 -> 1 / 0% / 1. Rounded top radius = 52px (static). Content readable by p=0.7 (op 0.84) exactly as C4. Mid-rise frame (panel translateY 42%): the cream rounded panel half-up over the brown aerial render, the big top-corner arc + lip-shadow visible, theme flipped brown->cream (matches 11tanjung C4). Probe (4x CPU throttle): 1/627 long frames (0.2%), 59.9fps -> PASS. Zero console errors.
